1a.law: Qenc(r)=integral_0^r 4*pi*u²*rho0*u²/a² du =4*pi*rho0*r^5/(5*a²). Gauss E=Qenc/(4*pi*eps*r²). V(a)=rho0*a²/(5*eps); integrate E inward to V(0)=rho0*a²/(4*eps).

1b.law: Qenc(r)=integral_0^r 4*pi*u²*rho0*u²/a² du =4*pi*rho0*r^5/(5*a²). Gauss E=Qenc/(4*pi*eps*r²). V(a)=rho0*a²/(5*eps); integrate E inward to V(0)=rho0*a²/(4*eps).

1c.law: Qenc(r)=integral_0^r 4*pi*u²*rho0*u²/a² du =4*pi*rho0*r^5/(5*a²). Gauss E=Qenc/(4*pi*eps*r²). V(a)=rho0*a²/(5*eps); integrate E inward to V(0)=rho0*a²/(4*eps).

2a.law: Image -q at -d; force Fz=-q²/(16*pi*eps*d²). Induced total=-q. Quasistatic Wext=-integral_d^(2d)Fz(h)dh=q²/(32*pi*eps*d)>0. No fictitious charge-pair energy is used.

2b.law: Image -q at -d; force Fz=-q²/(16*pi*eps*d²). Induced total=-q. Quasistatic Wext=-integral_d^(2d)Fz(h)dh=q²/(32*pi*eps*d)>0. No fictitious charge-pair energy is used.

3a.law: Ienc=2*pi*J0*integral_0^s (u-u³/a²)du=pi*J0*(s²-s^4/(2*a²)). Itotal=pi*J0*a²/2; solve for J0. Bphi=mu*Ienc/(2*pi*s), outside use total I; positive +phi for +z current.

3b.law: Ienc=2*pi*J0*integral_0^s (u-u³/a²)du=pi*J0*(s²-s^4/(2*a²)). Itotal=pi*J0*a²/2; solve for J0. Bphi=mu*Ienc/(2*pi*s), outside use total I; positive +phi for +z current.

3c.law: Ienc=2*pi*J0*integral_0^s (u-u³/a²)du=pi*J0*(s²-s^4/(2*a²)). Itotal=pi*J0*a²/2; solve for J0. Bphi=mu*Ienc/(2*pi*s), outside use total I; positive +phi for +z current.

4a.law: curl(M)=(0,-dMz/ds,0)=(0,-2*M0*s/a²,0); K=M×s_hat=(0,M0,0) at a. No free currents and div M=0, M.n=0 imply zero demagnetizing H with H(infinity)=0: H=0 everywhere, B=mu*M inside, B=0 outside. Tangential B jump matches K_bound.

4b.law: curl(M)=(0,-dMz/ds,0)=(0,-2*M0*s/a²,0); K=M×s_hat=(0,M0,0) at a. No free currents and div M=0, M.n=0 imply zero demagnetizing H with H(infinity)=0: H=0 everywhere, B=mu*M inside, B=0 outside. Tangential B jump matches K_bound.

5a.law: Phi=B0*A0*(1+t/T)*(1+t/(2T)). emf=-N*dPhi/dt=-N*B0*A0/T*(3/2+t/T). RL current from I(t)=exp(-t/tau)/L*integral_0^t exp(u/tau)*emf(u)du, tau=L/R. Joule heat by independent quadrature of R*I². Negative current is clockwise viewed from +z.

5b.law: Phi=B0*A0*(1+t/T)*(1+t/(2T)). emf=-N*dPhi/dt=-N*B0*A0/T*(3/2+t/T). RL current from I(t)=exp(-t/tau)/L*integral_0^t exp(u/tau)*emf(u)du, tau=L/R. Joule heat by independent quadrature of R*I². Negative current is clockwise viewed from +z.

6a.law: Rod +y moving +x in B+z has emf along -y. I=-B*ell*v/R, drag force along -x. Newton: m vprime=F0-(B*ell)² v/R. v=v_inf(1-exp(-t/tau)), tau=mR/(B*ell)². Joule heat from analytic integral of R I².

6b.law: Rod +y moving +x in B+z has emf along -y. I=-B*ell*v/R, drag force along -x. Newton: m vprime=F0-(B*ell)² v/R. v=v_inf(1-exp(-t/tau)), tau=mR/(B*ell)². Joule heat from analytic integral of R I².
